description: B7 SIDED AND TRIMMED (SIDING-TRIM; docs/reference-parts/buildings.md B7 Siding and trim, docs/BACKLOG.md SIDING-TRIM, Chief Architect's wall-type siding layer and Materials List): B7 drawn today, every default kept: its 288 x 192 outline sketch, loft.floor 1.3.0, loft.wall 1.5.0 in 2x6 with 7/16 OSB on the floor, the door and five windows at loft.door / loft.window 1.5.0 picked by call size (3068, 3 x 3040, 2 x 2030) with their units drawn, and loft.roof 1.8.0 (6/12 gable, ceiling joists, gable ends). The walls' Exterior finish is its default, fibre-cement lap 8-1/4 at 7 in (5/16 thick) with 10% waste: the lap on the OSB from the foundation top (Z 0) to the top plate (108.59375) between 5/4x4 corner boards (two a corner, the side wall's lapping the front or back wall's edge), cut out round 5/4x4 picture-frame casing on each unit, and carried up each gable over its OSB by the roof; every rafter tail is notched out of the lap or an eave wall's corner board. model.json is EXACTLY the sketch and the expansions with their member materials; members.json is each body's member metadata with its plugin (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_siding_trim.py pins both; services/geometry/tests/test_siding_b7.py checks the STEP, interference, the cut list, the mass and ten more cases).
derivation: INDEPENDENT of the plugins: services/geometry/tests/test_siding_b7.py's script() is test_outline_b7.script(units=True) (B7 with its 12 unit bodies), test_opening_update_b7's 18 middle plies and spacers, test_ceiling_joists_b7's 11 joists, test_gable_ends_b7's 22 gable studs and 12 gable OSB panels (288 solids) and the finish typed from buildings.md in _siding_builder.py (41): the lap 5/16 outside the OSB, X 3 1/16 .. 284 15/16 on the front and back and Y 2 1/16 .. 189 15/16 on the sides, Z 0 .. 108.59375, less each cased opening's box (a 3040's unit centred in its rough opening cased 43 x 55, a 2030's 31 x 43, the door's 37.5 x 82 frame 44.5 x 85.5 on the subfloor) and the rafter tails that cross it; 8 corner boards 1 x 3.5 x 108.59375 (the 4 on the eave walls notched by the end rafters); 23 mitred casing quads 1 in deep; the gables' lap over Y -7/16 .. 192 7/16 from the plate to the rafters' top plane. The STEP matches the 329 solids solid for solid (volume to 1e-4 in^3, bounds to 1e-5 in).

finish volume (analytic, test_the_finish_numbers_are_buildings_mds): lap (939.5 x 108.59375 - 13 565.75) x 5/16 - 22 tails x 1.27197265625 = 27 615.1660 in^3; corner boards 8 x 3.5 x 108.59375 - 4 x 4.328125 = 3 023.3125; casing rings 3 x (43 x 55 - 36 x 48) + 2 x (31 x 43 - 24 x 36) + (44.5 x 85.5 - 37.5 x 82) = 3 578.75; gables 2 x 5 705.185554 x 5/16 = 3 565.740971. A tail's notch over a layer w thick outside the OSB is 1.5 x 1/2 x (29/6 w + ((7/16 + w)^2 - (7/16)^2) / 2).

volume (analytic): b7-units' 276 916.8788656 + plies and spacers 2 949.375 + joists 22 887.596423 + gable ends 9 260.037360 + walls' finish 34 217.228516 + gables' lap 3 565.740971 = 349 796.857 in^3.

surface_area, centroid, mass_g and center_of_mass are the scripts' solids summed (expected_numbers()): spf_lumber 450, southern_pine_pt 582, osb 641, plywood 577, pvc 1 400, glass 2 500 and fibre_cement 1 200 kg/m^3.
bounding_box: b7-gable-ends' but X -1 7/16 and 289 7/16 (the side walls' corner boards), the Y bounds the 12 in eaves'.
topology and MESH from the scripts' B-rep, every face planar: a face of n edge-vertices on h holes meshes as n + 2h - 2 triangles. The kernel's build of model.json meets every count exactly.

The cut list (test_siding_b7): one siding line of 6 layers, 99 778.902 in^2 measured, x 1.10 / 1 008 = 108.89, 109 boards; 8 corner boards of 108.59375 on 10 ft; 23 casing pieces, 1 099.5 in. Interference none (test_nothing_interferes probes every pair whose boxes overlap, exactly).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), b7-gable-ends' class: the bounds are ABSOLUTE over ~5.7e9 mm^3 summed across 329 bodies (an ULP of the sum is ~9.5e-7). The kernel differs from the script by -3.8e-06 mm^3 on the volume, -7.2e-07 mm^2 on the area, <= 7.3e-12 mm on the centroid and centre of mass, 1.4e-9 g on the mass and 0 on the bounds. 2e-5 is 5.2x the worst; one corner board missed takes 380 in^3 (6.2e6 mm^3) and one casing piece 120 in^3, so either fails by eleven orders.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: KERNEL-LEVEL, b7-outline's class, measured 2026-10-29: OCCT's STEP writer rounds the sloped rafters', the notched OSB, lap and corner boards', the snipped joists', the gable studs' and the gable panels' and lap's irrational coordinates. Round-trip drift: volume -4.08e-4 mm^3, area -2.16e-5 mm^2. 1e-3 is 2.5x the worst and the b2-roof goldens' bound; it applies to volume and area only, the centroid and bounds keep ROUNDTRIP_TOL.
